crypt_blowfish 1.3 — bcrypt password hashing (OpenBSD-compatible, $2b$ prefix)
Source: https://www.openwall.com/crypt/  (crypt_blowfish-1.3.tar.gz)
Author: Solar Designer <solar at openwall.com>, 1998-2014

Vendored files: crypt_blowfish.c, crypt_blowfish.h (unmodified).
Not vendored: crypt_gensalt.c/h (traditional/MD5 salts), wrapper.c (glibc crypt(3) glue), x86.S (asm).
